fields.summary_ko.0: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) received Outperform rating from Oppenheimer with $600 target price (16.5% upside), Q3 revenue increased 44% to $13.4 billion with data center revenue up 97% to $8.5 billion.
fields.summary_ko.1: Marvell Technology (MRVL) received Outperform rating with $425 target price (175% upside), fiscal Q2 revenue increased 37% to $2.74 billion, with Lumentum acquisition ($115 billion) in progress.
fields.summary_ko.2: AMD's data center revenue is expected to grow 135% in 2027, representing approximately 85% of total revenue, with Marvell acquisition completion expected in H1 2028.
